judgement.reason: Grist can store its SQLite documents in S3 through its external storage setting, so contained changes can make it run and DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (GRIST_DATA_DIR=/persist/docs (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: Grist stores each document as a SQLite file in GRIST_DATA_DIR, and none of the shown lines set up S3 or another external store for those documents, so they would be lost on every restart.
